description: 在沿岸、河川或湖泊之不使用漁船採捕作業家數按經營組織型態分 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 行政院主計總處. 農林漁牧業普查之在沿岸、河川或湖泊之不使用漁船採捕作業之家數，觀察其經營組織型態為獨資餘戶、合夥、公司、漁會、試驗所、學校、其他情形. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 行政院主計總處. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2024-09-03 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
